# Superior Taekwondo

> A World Taekwondo (WT) club in North West Auckland, Helensville — Olympian-coached Tiny Tigers, General, Fitness, Poomsae, and Competition classes.

## About

Superior Taekwondo is a World Taekwondo (WT) club in North West Auckland, run by Andrea Kilday (2016 Rio Olympian, 3rd Dan, WT Level 2 coach). The club's slogan is "Constructing Champions".

Programmes:
- Tiny Tigers (kids from age 4)
- General (teens and adults)
- Fitness
- Poomsae
- Competition Team / Performance Pathway squad

Classes run six days a week. First week is free.

## Location & Contact

Helensville dojang: 94 Mill Road, Helensville 0875, Auckland, New Zealand

Phone: 027 520 1613
Email: superiorfitnessnz@gmail.com

## Pricing

- One session per week: $30/week
- Two sessions per week: $40/week
- Unlimited Taekwondo sessions: $50/week
- Sign-up fee: $40 (one-off, weekly memberships)
- 10-session concession card: $300 (valid 3 months)
- Free week trial: 1 week, any day
- Family discounts: 1st family member full price, 2nd 10% off, 3rd 15% off, 4th 20% off
- Weekly memberships: 26-week minimum term, then week to week
- Cancellations: two weeks' written notice to superiorfitnessnz@gmail.com; a $250 early-cancellation fee applies during the 26-week minimum term (or the remaining fees for the term if less)
- Holds: 3 to 8 weeks, once per 12 months; payments pause and the minimum term is extended by the hold
- Extra Poomsae or tournament-preparation classes: $20 per student per session for members not on unlimited
- Club shop (uniforms and gear): https://superior-taekwondo.gymdesk.com/shop
- All training is at the Helensville location, 94 Mill Road

## Classes & Bookings
